author: octpusser
quote: Absolutely not a GTA entry, at best a cuck boyfriend simulator. Lucia's character is the most toxic woman you would ever engage with, Jason's writing is as bland as white bread can get, and the pacing is incredibly slow with characters that have near zero personality. The only redeeming quality is the graphics but the framerate issues are not what we should get after 13 years and the budget they have. Don't forget the bugs that rival with Cyberpunk 2077 on release, the forced messaging and the burger flipping mission. This was not written by GTA fans, nor is for GTA fans. Save your money.
